single.rationale: Omada demonstrates exceptional growth trajectory (53% revenue growth FY25) with rapidly improving unit economics - operating losses shrunk from $66M to $12M while achieving positive operating cash flow of $18M. The company operates in a large addressable market with strong customer retention metrics (55% still engaged at month 12) and recently secured substantial capital ($145M cash increase), positioning it well for potential profitability in FY26.

team.thesis: Omada Health achieved a critical financial inflection in FY2025, generating positive operating cash flow of $18.3M after years of burn and accelerating revenue growth to 53.2% while reaching $260.2M, but the business model faces high structural fragility: customer concentration intensified sharply to 77% from 68% two years prior, revenue depends on contracts requiring repayment if engagement targe
